name: clayers
description: Local-first Codex plugin for invoking Clayers-owned knowledge workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Run Clayers-owned local workflows from a repo.
interface.longDescription: Clayers helps Codex bootstrap the local Clayers CLI, adopt a repository, request Clayers-owned sync/generation when available, and report spec health, drift, coverage, and connectivity from the local checkout.
